name: LEANING DUMBBELL ONE LEG CALF RAISE LEFT
introduce: Hold a dumbbell in your left hand and stand with the ball of your left foot on a stable bench or something similar. \n\nUse your right hand to hold onto something to maintain balance. Lift your left heel up and down.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell or something similar.
Please raise your heel up as high as you can.
Please squeeze your calf when raising your heel up.
Please fully stretch your calf when lowering your heel down.
Exhale when lifting your heel and inhale when lowering it.
Please pause for a short time at the top for a better result.
You should feel your calf burning.
